# Results (generated by src/make_report.py; do not edit by hand)

Dataset: 2452 GitHub issues from 15 Android apps, 1180 accessibility and 1272 comparison. Text: description (issue body) only. Features: feature hashing, 1024 features, n-grams 1 to 2. Labels are weak labels: selected by repository labels and a keyword search, not hand-verified, so they are not ground truth. These scores are not comparable to the paper's (different data source, different labelling, different class ratio). 161 issues are in 47 groups of exact or near duplicates (cosine >= 0.9); a group never crosses train and test.

## Experiment 1: the paper's pipeline, 10-fold stratified CV, raw text

Mean ± SD over the 10 folds.

| Classifier | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 | AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Decision Tree (single) | 0.841 ± 0.029 | 0.846 ± 0.038 | 0.822 ± 0.048 | 0.833 ± 0.032 | 0.884 ± 0.025 |
| Decision Tree (boosted) | 0.875 ± 0.021 | 0.898 ± 0.023 | 0.835 ± 0.040 | 0.865 ± 0.024 | 0.931 ± 0.021 |
| Random Forest | 0.744 ± 0.023 | 0.735 ± 0.032 | 0.736 ± 0.036 | 0.735 ± 0.022 | 0.830 ± 0.030 |
| SVM (linear) | 0.794 ± 0.046 | 0.835 ± 0.124 | 0.766 ± 0.145 | 0.779 ± 0.050 | 0.902 ± 0.015 |
| Neural Network | 0.812 ± 0.022 | 0.836 ± 0.101 | 0.793 ± 0.134 | 0.799 ± 0.035 | 0.907 ± 0.024 |
| Keyword rule (reference, not trained) | 0.918 ± 0.019 | 0.997 ± 0.006 | 0.833 ± 0.042 | 0.907 ± 0.024 | 0.915 ± 0.020 |

## Extension: leave-one-app-out and keyword masking

F1 (AUC in brackets). 10-fold rows: mean over folds. Leave-one-app-out rows: pooled over all 15 held-out apps (each app scored by a model trained on the other 14, minus any near-duplicate of a held-out issue). Masked: accessib*, a11y, talkback/talk back and screen reader(s) removed from the description before preprocessing.

| Classifier | 10-fold, raw | 10-fold, masked | Leave-one-app-out, raw | Leave-one-app-out, masked |
|---|---|---|---|---|
